note: fovy 120->70: at 64 px a 120 deg field spans 1.875 deg/px, so the 1.6 deg dot E. macularius is measured to track (Masseck 2008) covers 0.85 px and cannot be resolved at all; at 70 deg it covers 1.46 px. texrepeat 6->50 (16.7 cm -> 2 cm squares): the corpus gives NO texture scale, only 'coarse-grained so it does not alias at 64x64', so 2 cm is INVENTED, chosen to sit above the ~1 mm/px Nyquist limit while giving about five features per body length for optic flow. prey radius 0.009 m is an INVENTED sphere proxy for published 0.30-0.40 SVL prey.
